title: Witch and Melting Clock
description: A woman in a dark purple robe with golden symbols stands in a mystical laboratory, reaching toward a large swirling clock on the wall that appears to be melting with vibrant colorful paint drips. The room contains shelves filled with glowing potion bottles, an open book on the counter with visible text, hanging lanterns, and a green butterfly near the clock.
prompt: A woman in a long dark purple robe covered in golden alchemical symbols stands in profile reaching with her hand toward a large melting clock on the wall. The clock has golden numbers and black hands, surrounded by swirling colorful paint strokes in green, red, blue and purple that drip down the wall. A green butterfly flies nearby. The scene is set in a mystical laboratory with wooden shelves holding many glowing potion jars, an open spellbook on the marble counter, hanging lanterns with clock faces, and an hourglass with red ribbon.
